description: Create house.furniture, with the self-reference that links chairs to the table they belong to.
rationale: A dining set is one table and six chairs, and the household thinks of it as one thing. parent_item_id is that grouping, and it points at furniture rather than at item so a chair cannot be filed under a saucepan.

intents.comment: Detail for an item of category furniture. One row per house.item row.

columns.name: item_id
columns.comment: The house.item row this extends. Primary key and foreign key at once, which is what makes the pair exactly one-to-one.

columns.name: material
columns.comment: Dominant material: oak, pine, steel, fabric.

columns.name: seats
columns.comment: How many people it seats. Null for anything that is not seating.

columns.name: parent_item_id
columns.comment: The piece this one belongs to -- the table a chair goes with. Null for a piece that stands alone.

intents.name: furniture_parent_item_id_idx
intents.comment: Leads with the referencing column of furniture_parent_fk, and answers 'what goes with this table'.

intents.name: furniture_kind_idx
intents.comment: All the chairs, all the shelves.

intents.name: furniture_not_own_parent
intents.expression: parent_item_id IS NULL OR parent_item_id <> item_id
